run_context.purpose: Flexibility rework of the rally-then-cup detector: per-criterion soft scores, composite + tier, three presets. High-RECALL numeric stage; the chart-viewing step is the precision stage.
run_context.universe: 107 NSE symbols (pre-supplied parquet, not the full EQ list)
run_context.hourly_parquet: hourly_closed.parquet - the 37 degenerate 15:30 IST bars (open=high=low=close, volume 0) dropped per SKILL.md step 3. Running the raw hourly.parquet loses ENTERO and yields 11 detector hits, not 12; the strict baseline is defined on the closed-bar file.
run_context.daily_params: base_min 10, base_max 40, rally_max_bars 60, lookback 150 (references/parameters.md timeframe notes)
run_context.charts_viewed: 10 PNGs opened with the Read tool: 8 newly-surfaced hourly names, 2 newly-surfaced daily names.

PRICOLLTD.note: 5-week sustained staircase 597->822 on rising stacked EMAs, tight 4-session base right under the high, no dominant candle. Missed strict only on ema_stack 0.994.

VIJAYA.note: Clean daily uptrend at all-time highs; 2.9%-deep, 6-session tight base 1480-1515 with EMA20/50 rising underneath. Shallowest base in the batch (RRR 5.2).

ASAHIINDIA.note: Rally 862->971 into a shallow 3.3% consolidation closing AT the high, EMAs stacked and rising, breaking a 6-month daily base. Missed on curvature 0.0127 vs 0.0150 - genuinely a shallow base.

CUPID.note: Real parabolic daily trend and a tight 4-session shelf, but an 18-Aug flush wick to 235 sits inside the window and the true high 299 is ~5% above the detector lip 290.9.

TDPOWERSYS.note: Rally is genuine and sustained, but the base is a 3-session fade off the 18-Aug 1597 spike with the right side not yet curling; price 3.4% under the lip. Ranked #5 - the worst ranking miss in the batch.

ZENTEC.note: Post-spike V dip off 2039.5 that has only half recovered; close is 5.5% under the lip and a June supply shelf sits at 2000-2020.

HEG.note: Flat shelf under a failed one-session 749 spike. shape 0.03, flagged SHAPE_WEAK, ranked 15th.

QUESS.note: Ragged post-spike shelf, r2 0.374, price mid-range 4.4% under a 2-session-old lip. shape 0.28, flagged SHAPE_WEAK, ranked 16th.

SONACOMS.note: Daily: sustained 480->844 advance on stacked rising EMAs with a shallow 10-session consolidation under the high. Missed on curvature 0.0129 and vol_dryup 0.889.

SHRIRAMFIN.note: Daily: recovery 890->1153.7 above a rising EMA200, tight 4.4% base near the high, RRR 3.4. Missed on curvature 0.0138.

refusals.decision: REFUSED to soften. Kept a HARD exclusion, never scored.
refusals.why: It is the only filter here whose failure mode is invisible to the reviewer. A 120-bar chart shows a clean rally into a base; the 20% decline before it and the overhead supply the base sits under are off-screen, so no amount of eyeballing corrects for it. Excluded names are still emitted in hard_excluded with their number attached so the count is auditable.
refusals.cost: On daily this over-fires on ETERNAL (90.0%), a visually-confirmed setup: postfilter measures against ALL bars in a 250-bar daily file, which is a 1-year high test rather than 60-day. --high-window-bars 60 (daily) / 420 (hourly) applies the documented rule, but the default stays full-file because strict must reproduce the prior run byte for byte.

refusals.what: vertex_window, the documented numeric defence against V-bounces
refusals.decision: Band granted so the near-miss is visible, but a vertex miss can NEVER buy tier B - it is capped at C and flagged VERTEX_LOOSENED.
refusals.why: Widening the vertex window is precisely the loosening that would smuggle a V-bounce into a promoted tier. Tier A is by construction "passes every gate at its ideal", so no loosening reaches A either.

refusals.decision: REFUSED to build one as a gate. shape is a RANKING signal only.
refusals.why: Measured, not assumed: fitting an explicit two-segment V model against the parabola and comparing residuals came out BACKWARDS on the labelled batch - the kink-searched V fit PAYTM (confirmed cup) better than BLISSGVS (confirmed V-dip). SKILL.md is right that no threshold separates these. leg-symmetry merely correlates (all five confirmed names >= 0.66), which is enough to rank on and not enough to gate on.

refusals.what: The exploratory preset’s one free failure
refusals.why: A zero on those is not a loose cup, it is the opposite shape: curvature <= 0 is an inverted parabola (a dome), and vol_dryup > ~1.5 is base volume EXPANDING against the rally. Before this rule exploratory admitted four domes (SENORES -0.016, BAJAJ-AUTO -0.016, RADICO -0.020, HNDFDS -0.009) and floated SIGMAADV (vol ratio 15.8x) into its top ten. bar_share deliberately still gets the free failure - a one-candle leg is a real if different setup, admitted with a GAP_DRIVEN flag.
